context.summary: On a chilly day in Ypsilanti on November 20, 2024, Andrew, Jacob, Lucas, and myself gathered at the Eastern Michigan vs Buffalo football game, our smiles as warm as our jackets. what: After an entire semester of banter between Jacob and myself we finally got to go to the Eastern Michigan vs Buffalo football game. Since he’s from Michigan and his mom went to Eastern and I’m from New York and my mom went to Buffalo we both had a stake in the game. The actual game itself was miserable as both teams were not good and it was cold and wet but it was well worth it. We went to a Halal place for dinner after and got good food. Buffalo won the game by a lot by the end.
